stack.frontend: HTML templates, vanilla JavaScript, static CSS

design.direction: Professional financial-administration workspace with clear information hierarchy and restrained Persian geometric ornament

decisions: Keep the Django template and vanilla JavaScript architecture; do not introduce React, Tailwind, or a build pipeline.
Use the midnight navy and violet visual system consistently across the dashboard, tables, forms, dialogs, and settings.
Keep dense financial data readable with clear labels, restrained row hover, semantic status colors, and responsive overflow where needed.
Use geometric ornament sparingly and reserve saturated color for primary actions, statuses, and financial emphasis.
Provide visible keyboard focus, accessible labels, responsive layout, and reduced-motion support.
constraints: Preserve financial behavior and audit history.
Never expose member document storage publicly.
Sensitive tariff changes and financial reversals require manager approval and a recorded reason.
